title: Telespazio Hackathon – Space Edition: D.R.A.C.O.
description: How a team brainstorm at the 2026 Space Edition became D.R.A.C.O., a conceptual proposal for a satellite constellation.
paragraphs: How could a satellite constellation help monitor what happens on land, at sea and in orbit? That was our starting point at the 2026 Space Edition.

My teammates and I came to the question from different disciplines. We spent time thinking it through together, and the brainstorm took shape as D.R.A.C.O., short for Defensive Reconnaissance and Orbital Control System. We presented it at the hackathon as a conceptual proposal for bringing those three kinds of monitoring together in one constellation.

What I took home from the experience was how much I’d learned from the people around me. Thank you to Alessio Pompeo, Simone Bianchi, Aurelio Arpaia, Michelangelo Dini, Giuseppe Pisano and Caterina Taddei. It was a pleasure working through the idea with all of you.
Thanks to the teams at Telespazio and e-GEOS for bringing us together for the hackathon.
